name: YOKO
source: Amidst the echoes of trauma, YOKO has lost her memories. Her alluring physique combined with her inherently innocent and vibrant nature naturally captivates those around her. Not by design but simply by being herself, she becomes a cherished figure amongst the men who've survived within the confines of the shopping mall.
